title: Transport of monoidal unit replacement edges under a strong monoidal Quillen functor
statement:
Let $H:\mathcal M\to\mathcal N$ be an enriched strong monoidal left Quillen functor between closed symmetric monoidal differential graded model categories satisfying the model and enrichment axioms of [lem-coef-dg-model-mapping-comparison]. Left Quillen means that $H$ has an enriched right adjoint and preserves cofibrations and trivial cofibrations. The tensor has an enriched internal-Hom right adjoint in each variable, and its pushout product is a cofibration for cofibrations and trivial if either input is trivial. Assume the unit axiom in both categories: for a cofibrant replacement $t:U\to\mathbf1$, both $t\otimes K$ and $K\otimes t$ are weak equivalences for cofibrant $K$. Strong monoidal means that specified invertible tensor and unit comparisons satisfy the monoidal associativity and unit diagrams, and the symmetry diagram when $H$ is symmetric monoidal.

Let $q:Q\mathbf1_{\mathcal M}\to\mathbf1_{\mathcal M}$ be a cofibrant replacement. Suppose $v:H(Q\mathbf1_{\mathcal M})\xrightarrow{H(q)}H(\mathbf1_{\mathcal M})\cong\mathbf1_{\mathcal N}$ is a weak equivalence. Then for every cofibrant $K$ in $\mathcal N$ both composites
$$H(Q\mathbf1_{\mathcal M})\otimes K\xrightarrow{v\otimes1}\mathbf1_{\mathcal N}\otimes K\longrightarrow K,\qquad K\otimes H(Q\mathbf1_{\mathcal M})\xrightarrow{1\otimes v}K\otimes\mathbf1_{\mathcal N}\longrightarrow K$$
are weak equivalences, with final arrows the unitors. More generally form a finite nonempty tensor word in cofibrant objects of $\mathcal M$ and occurrences of $Q\mathbf1_{\mathcal M}$, and replace any subset of these occurrences by $\mathbf1_{\mathcal M}$ using $q$. Applying $H$ to this cube and using its strong monoidal comparisons identifies its edges with replacement by $v$ in the corresponding tensor words of $\mathcal N$. Every such edge is a weak equivalence. The edge maps commute with the specified associativity and unit diagrams of $H$ and of the two monoidal categories, and with symmetry diagrams when $H$ is symmetric monoidal.
